claim: Overview of the best things to do in Kota Kinabalu (2026), spanning islands, culture, nature and city sights.
quote: THE 15 BEST Things to Do in Kota Kinabalu (2026)

claim: TARP is five islands of snorkel/dive/watersport just offshore from KK, Malaysia's first marine park.
quote: The Tunku Abdul Rahman Marine Park comprises 5 islands where you can enjoy water activities such as snorkeling, diving, trekking, jetski, parasailing and many more water sports.

claim: TARP island-hop boat rates RM35 (1 island) to RM75 (4), plus RM25 international park fee and RM7 terminal fee; gear RM15/hr; standard route Manukan-Sapi-Mamutik; best March-September.
quote: Ferry pricing includes RM45 for two islands and RM55 for three islands, with a single island costing RM35 and four islands costing RM65... entry fee is RM25 for international adults, with a terminal fee of RM7.

claim: Official Sabah Parks page for Tunku Abdul Rahman Park (Gaya, Sapi, Manukan, Mamutik, Sulug).
quote: Tunku Abdul Rahman Park - The Official Sabah Parks Website

claim: June 2026 EUR/MYR around 4.60-4.70; 2026 average ~4.76 MYR per EUR.
quote: the exchange rate of Euro to Malaysian ringgits fluctuated between a high of 4.70355 on 08-06-2026 and a low of 4.60772 on 02-06-2026... average 1 Euro = 4.7635 Malaysian Ringgit.

claim: Padas rafting is Grade III-IV, RM379-415pp 2026, minimum age 12, reached by Tenom-Pangi vintage train then 9-10km whitewater; full 12h day.
quote: Group of 10-19 people: MYR 379 per person... Minimum Age for Padas Rafting Tour is 12 years old... travel by vintage train from Tenom to Pangi station, then raft 9-10 kilometers downstream

claim: Kiulu River is Grade I-II, gentle and suitable for beginners, families and first-timers.
quote: Top White Water Rafting in Sabah - Kiulu River (Grade I-II)

claim: Kiulu rafting Class I-II, safe for children (ages 5+) and elderly, 60-90 min on the water.
quote: Kiulu River is classified as Class I - II River. It is safe enough for children and gentle enough for the elderly... Children aged 5 and above can join.

claim: Kiulu combo packages add a 320m jungle zipline and self-drive ATV; runs daily, valid through 2026.
quote: Climb an exhilarating 18-meter tower, then zip into the jungle for an adrenaline-pumping 320-meter ride... explore the rugged terrain on an exhilarating ATV ride.

claim: Klias proboscis-monkey & firefly cruise USD67-76/adult 2026, 8h, 112km/~2h each way south of KK.
quote: 2-3 pax: USD 76 per adult... Total duration: 8 Hours... Distance from Kota Kinabalu: 112km to Klias Peninsula.

claim: Mengkabong sunset river cruise with fireflies is a closer (Tuaran) alternative to Klias.
quote: Mengkabong Sunset River Cruise and Fireflies Watching

claim: Mengkabong (~45 min in Tuaran) offers mangrove kayaking with Mount Kinabalu views; calm water for self-paddling.
quote: Activities you can do at Mengkabong River include boat rides, mangrove kayaking, birdwatching and fireflies watching... beautiful views of Mount Kinabalu, mangrove forest.

claim: Poring canopy walkway is 105m suspended 30m up; outdoor hot-spring bathtubs are free, indoor tubs chargeable (RM10 outdoor tub).
quote: Poring's canopy walkway is a 105m length walkway suspended 30m above unspoiled flora... Poring Hot Spring Outdoor Bathtubs are for complimentary use and are free of charge.

claim: Poring canopy walk temporarily closed for maintenance with visitors redirected to Silau-Silau trail; single-use plastic bags banned in all Sabah Parks from 1 Jan 2026.
quote: The Poring Hot Spring Canopy Walk is temporarily closed for major maintenance... Effective 1 January 2026, the use of single-use plastic bags is strictly prohibited in all Sabah Parks.

claim: Kinabalu Park conservation fee RM50 for international adults (RM10 Malaysian), plus RM5/vehicle and a small botanical-garden fee.
quote: Conservation fees for the park include RM 10.00 for Malaysian adults and RM 50.00 for international adults, plus RM 5.00 per vehicle.

claim: Kinabalu Park HQ has botanical/nature trails (incl. Silau-Silau) you can walk without the summit climb.
quote: Kinabalu Park - The Official Sabah Parks Website

claim: Botanical garden open 9:00-16:00 with free guided walks at 9/12/15:00; pitcher plants, orchids, endemic pink medinilla; easy boardwalk; good no-summit option.
quote: open to the public from 9:00am to 4:00pm daily... conducted guided tour... scheduled at 9:00am, 12:00pm, and 3:00pm... pitcher plants, and the prominent Pink Medinilla plant endemic to Kinabalu.

claim: Tip of Borneo full-day trip includes Kota Belud, Rungus longhouse lunch, gong-making, honeybee centre, and Tanjung Simpang Mengayau headland.
quote: a visit to a Rungus longhouse... Kampung Sumangkap to see how traditional gongs are made... the Borneo Honeybee Centre... finishes at Tanjung Simpang Mengayau.

claim: Kudat/Tip of Borneo is ~2.5h drive north of KK where the South China and Sulu seas meet.
quote: From Kota Kinabalu to Kudat: A Road Trip to the Tip of Borneo

claim: Mantanani snorkel day-trip ~USD63 (2026), 11h, ~1h drive to Kota Belud jetty + 40min boat; two snorkel sites, white-sand beach, optional kayak/SUP.
quote: The 2026 adult rate is USD 63... Land transfer: Approximately 1 hour to Riverside Jetty in Kota Belud... 40 minutes boat ride... Total duration: 11 hours.

claim: Mari Mari Cultural Village showcases 5 indigenous Bornean tribes with blowpipe, fire-starting, rice-wine demos and lunch; daily tours 10:00 and 14:00, ~4h.
quote: discover 5 indigenous tribes of North Borneo... Daily guided tours are available at 10:00 AM and 2:00 PM... blowpipe making, fire starting, and tattooing.

claim: North Borneo Cruises sunset dinner cruise from USD59 (2026), 2h around TARP islands and KK waterfront from Sutera Marina with buffet.
quote: starts from USD 59 for 2026... two-hour journey... cruise begins at Sutera Marina Jetty at 17:00 hours.

claim: Official North Borneo Cruises operator (Sabah premier sunset & night cruise).
quote: North Borneo Cruises: Sabah Premier Sunset & Night Cruise

claim: Atkinson Clock Tower (1902, WWII survivor) and Signal Hill Observatory overlook the waterfront; Gaya Street Sunday Market (Chinatown) ends ~13:00; waterfront is the sunset/food hub.
quote: The Atkinson Clock Tower... built in 1902... Signal Hill Observatory Platform... great place for a spectacular view... Gaya Street... market is held... finishes at 1 PM.

claim: Signal Hill Observatory Platform visitor info; free hilltop city/island viewpoint best at sunset.
quote: Visitor Information | Signal Hill

claim: TARP reefs suit beginner divers (Sapi/Mamutik) with frogfish, clownfish, turtles, black-tip reef sharks and rays.
quote: marine creatures such as Frogfish, Octopus, Sea horses, and Turtles, Black Tip Reef Sharks, Eagle rays.

claim: Discover Scuba (no licence) at TARP ~USD106 local / USD115 international 2026, two dives (shore + boat to 12m), 7h, includes gear, park fees, transfers, lunch.
quote: USD 106 (Malaysia Market), USD 159 (International Market, before promotion discount to USD 115)... 01 Confined Water Training & Shore Dive, 01 Boat Dive... Duration: 7 hours.

claim: Twin-island + sea-walking package priced at RM300.
quote: Twin Islands + Sea Walking - MYR 300

claim: Twin-island + parasailing package priced at RM210 incl. safety equipment.
quote: Twin Islands + Parasailing - MYR 210

claim: Combo of 2-island hopping + banana boat + parasailing + sea-walking from RM190.
quote: 2 Island Hopping, Banana Boat, Parasailing and Sea Walking @RM190

claim: Desa Dairy Farm in Kundasang (~2h from KK) costs RM5, requires online tickets (no walk-ins); 'Little New Zealand' pastures under Mount Kinabalu, paired with War Memorial.
quote: Entrance tickets cost RM5.00 per person and must be purchased online in advance, as the farm does not accept walk-ins... nicknamed 'The Little New Zealand' of Sabah.

claim: Desa Cattle Dairy Farm offers Mt-Kinabalu pasture views, milking/calf-feeding and dairy products.
quote: Desa Cattle Dairy Farm | Sabah Tourism Board

claim: Lok Kawi Wildlife Park (~25km from KK) charges RM20 international adult; orangutan, pygmy elephant, proboscis monkey; open 9:30-17:30.
quote: RM20 for foreign adult tourists... orangutans, proboscis monkeys... open for visitors from 9:30 am to 5:30 pm.

claim: Tanjung Aru (~6km SW of KK) is the local free sunset spot with casual seafood grills; arrive ~17:30.
quote: the go-to spot for both locals and travelers to witness the sun dipping into the South China Sea... casual seafood scene right by the sand.

claim: Tanjung Aru is ~6km from KK city centre, good for a half-day/evening; sunset ~6:00-6:30 PM.
quote: Located just 6 km from Kota Kinabalu city center, Tanjung Aru Beach is easily accessible... Sunset Time: Around 6:00 PM - 6:30 PM.

claim: Mahua Waterfall (Crocker Range, ~1.5-2h from KK) is a 17m fall reached by a flat ~500m walk; RM10 international entry; best Feb-Sep.
quote: a 17-meter-high waterfall hidden within the Crocker Range Park... A short 500 meter walk provides a refreshing dip... Non-Malaysian (18+): RM10.

claim: Official Sabah Parks page for Crocker Range Park (jungle trekking, Mahua, Mt Alab).
quote: Crocker Range Park - The Official Sabah Parks Website

claim: Crocker Range day trip offers a guided jungle trek with rafflesia, orchids, pitcher plants and a Mahua waterfall swim.
quote: see a flowering rafflesia, orchids and pitcher plants, and swim at the Mahua Waterfall.

claim: Tuaran cycling ride is ~22km through Dusun villages, plantations and coastal plain, mostly easy with minimal climbing, ~2.5-3h riding, hotel transfers and lunch included.
quote: ~22km bike tour... small riverside villages, jungle plantations and onto the coastal plain... mix of sealed and gravel roads with minimal climbing.

claim: Bike Borneo offers guided KK city/countryside day rides.
quote: Bike Borneo | Kota Kinabalu City Day Ride

claim: KK Wetland Centre is a 24.2ha mangrove Ramsar site ~3km from the city with a 1.3km boardwalk and observation tower.
quote: Kota Kinabalu Wetland Ramsar Site, which encompasses 24.2 hectares of mangrove forest... located only 3.3 km from the city centre.

claim: KK Wetland has ~80 bird species, entry RM10 (adults), open 8AM-6PM; best birding 8-10AM.
quote: Almost 80 species of birds have been identified... Entry is RM10 (adults)... best time to do bird-watching... is in the morning, 8:00 am - 10:00 am.

claim: Mount Kinabalu summit climb needs a permit + Panalaban/Laban Rata overnight; standard 2D1N package from ~RM1,560pp; 2026-2027 permits bookable.
quote: Standard 2D1N climb packages start from RM 1,560 per person for accommodation at Laban Rata... You are required to secure accommodation in Panalaban to apply for a climb permit.

claim: Via ferrata (Walk the Torq / Low's Peak Circuit) is a separate vertical add-on with age/height limits, accommodation at Pendant Hut.
quote: Via Ferrata packages include permit, guide, and accommodation at Pendant Hut... participants must be between at least 10 years old... and a minimum height of 1.3 metres.

claim: Filipino/Handicraft Market on the KK waterfront serves fresh seafood you pick and have cooked, ~RM30-60/pax, liveliest 5-10PM.
quote: You pick your seafood, decide on the cooking style... Average seafood dinner: RM 30-60 per person.

claim: Coral Flyer island-to-island zipline (Gaya-Sapi) reopened Dec 2025; 250m, two lines, ~65km/h; RM92 international / RM68 local.
quote: spans 250 meters between Gaya and Sapi islands... reaches speeds of up to 65kmh... RM68 for local/PR and RM92 for international visitors... reopened since 6th December 2025.

claim: Gaya Island Resort's Tavajun Bay is a secluded private beach on Pulau Gaya in TARP, a quiet alternative to crowded islands.
quote: the largest of a cluster of five islands that form the Tunku Abdul Rahman Marine Park... private beach at Tavajun Bay.

claim: A 1-day Crocker Range jungle trek combines Mt Alab (2,050m) with Mahua Waterfall as an accessible day-hike.
quote: 1 Day Borneo Jungle Trek with Mahua Waterfall (Mount Alab - 2,050M)
